COMPANY_UPDATE.description: Edit companies you have access to.

COMPANY_DELETE.description: Archive and restore companies you have access to. Archiving keeps their history and can be undone.

PERSON_UPDATE.description: Edit contacts you have access to.

PERSON_DELETE.description: Archive and restore contacts you have access to. Archiving keeps their history and can be undone.

DEAL_UPDATE.description: Edit deals you have access to.

DEAL_DELETE.description: Delete deals you have access to. If a deal has documents beyond draft, deletion also needs a built-in Owner or Admin role with no custom role assigned.

ACTIVITY_UPDATE.description: Edit activities you have access to. Activities captured from connected accounts remain read-only.

ACTIVITY_DELETE.description: Delete activities you have access to. Activities captured from connected accounts remain read-only.

NOTE_UPDATE.description: Edit notes you have access to.

NOTE_DELETE.description: Delete notes you have access to.

TASK_UPDATE.description: Edit tasks you have access to.

TASK_DELETE.description: Delete tasks you have access to.

REPORT_UPDATE.description: Edit reports you have access to.

REPORT_DELETE.description: Delete your own reports and snapshots. Deleting another member's work or a report containing scheduled snapshots needs a built-in Owner or Admin role with no custom role assigned.

COMMENT_CREATE.description: Add comments to records you have access to.

COMMENT_MODERATE.description: Remove other authors' comment text from accessible records; permission to add comments is also required. Authors can remove their own comments without moderation access.

ATTACHMENT_CREATE.description: Upload files to records you have access to.

ATTACHMENT_DELETE.description: Delete files you have access to. Deleting quarantined files also needs permission to manage quarantined files.

ATTACHMENT_QUARANTINE_MANAGE.description: Review and manage quarantined files. This does not grant access to their contents.

REPORT_READ.description: View workspace reports; creating and editing reports need separate permissions.

PIPELINE_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, and delete pipelines and their stages.

TAG_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, and delete workspace tags.

PRODUCT_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, and delete products in the workspace catalog.

DOCUMENT_MANAGE.action: Manage document templates and approval policies
DOCUMENT_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, and delete document templates and configure document approval policies. Editing deal documents needs permission to edit deals; sending and approving need separate permissions.

DOCUMENT_SEND.description: Send, resend, and void document deliveries.

DOCUMENT_APPROVE.description: Approve or reject documents routed for your review. This does not grant approval-policy management.

CUSTOM_FIELD_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, and delete custom field definitions.

SHARE_MANAGE.description: Manage sharing of this workspace's companies, contacts, and pipelines within the same organization. Sharing requires membership in the destination workspace; privacy protections still apply.

MEMBER_MANAGE.description: Invite and remove members and assign built-in roles within your authority. Only workspace owners can change ownership; new owners must accept. Assigning custom roles needs permission to manage roles.

ROLE_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, and assign custom roles within your own permissions, and delete unused roles. Changing a role held by an owner also requires workspace ownership. Custom roles do not grant ownership.

AUDIT_READ.description: View workspace audit history. Organization audit access is separate.

WORKSPACE_SETTINGS.description: Edit workspace settings. Organization security and single sign-on settings require organization authority. AI settings require organization administrator access.

API_CREDENTIAL_MANAGE.description: View the workspace's API credential list, issue your own credentials within your permissions, and revoke workspace credentials.

RULE_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, publish, and manage workspace workflows. Each action still requires its own access.

CAMPAIGN_VIEW.description: View campaigns and results. Viewing contact audiences also requires permission to manage contact preferences; editing and sending need separate permissions.

CAMPAIGN_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, and delete campaigns and manage messages and audiences. Contact audiences and draft sends also need permission to manage contact preferences; sending needs separate permission.

CAMPAIGN_SEND.description: Send campaigns to eligible recipients. Contact preferences and privacy protections still apply.

CONSENT_MANAGE.description: Manage marketing contact preferences for contacts owned by this workspace and manage its contact exclusions. Privacy protections still apply.

AI_USE.description: Use Ask Connex and AI features when enabled with an organization provider. This does not grant access to other members' private chats. AI settings require organization administrator access.

AI_SESSION_SHARE.description: Share your chats before they contain an AI answer and invite workspace members. You and participants also need permission to use AI features.

AI_SESSION_ADMIN.description: Read chats retained after their creator leaves the workspace. This does not allow changing them or sending messages on the creator's behalf.

SEQUENCE_VIEW.description: View sequence templates available to you. Editing and publishing need permission to manage sequences.

SEQUENCE_MANAGE.description: Create, edit, archive, and publish sequence templates available to you. This does not grant permission to send campaigns.

TEAM_MANAGE.description: Create teams and manage their members and managers. Team membership does not grant workspace permissions.
